The '''Herstell system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> The system contained the astronomical object [[Herstell V]].<ref name="HR" />
